journey.name: Presets
journey.description: On the Presets page (All presets, beside Start workout on the Timer): save the Timer's settings as a preset, put a built-in one on the Timer from its sheet, start one from its sheet, then edit and delete the saved one, and open a new preset from the title bar. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval), whose default workout matches no preset.

actions.action: Verify that the Timer tab is shown, its total labelled "Custom · Total"
Tap "All presets" beside "Start workout"
Verify that a page titled "Presets" is shown with "Back" and a "New preset" button in the title bar
Verify that a card captioned "On the Timer · not saved" is shown at the top with a "Save" button, reading "30s on · 15s off · ×8"
Verify that "Yours" is shown above "Built-in", and "Yours" says "Nothing saved yet" and "Save one from the Timer or the end of a workout."
Tap "Save" on the "On the Timer · not saved" card
Verify that a sheet titled "Save as preset" is shown with "Cancel", a "Name" field whose placeholder is "30/15 ×8" and a "0 / 24" count
Type "Tabata" into the "Name" field
Verify that "Saves as Tabata 2" is shown under the field
Clear the "Name" field and type "Journey"
Verify that the count reads "7 / 24"
Tap "Save" at the bottom of the sheet
Verify that a "Journey" card is shown under "Yours", captioned "On the Timer", and the "On the Timer · not saved" card is gone
Tap the "Tabata" card
Verify that a sheet is shown with "Built-in", "Tabata", "Start workout", "Put on Timer" and "Save a copy"
Tap "Put on Timer"
Verify that the Timer tab is shown, its total labelled "Tabata · Total", with no "Save as preset" button in the title bar
Tap "All presets"
Verify that the "Tabata" card under "Built-in" is captioned "On the Timer" and the "Journey" card is not
Tap the "Tabata" card
Verify that the sheet shows "Start workout" and "Save a copy" but no "Put on Timer", since Tabata is already on the Timer
Swipe the sheet down
Tap the "Journey" card
Verify that a sheet is shown with "Yours", "Journey", "Start workout", "Edit" and "Delete"
Tap "Start workout"
Verify that the workout screen is shown with "Get ready"
Tap "End workout" and confirm with "End workout" in the dialog
Verify that the Presets page is shown again, and the "Journey" card is captioned "On the Timer"
Tap the "Journey" card
Tap "Edit"
Verify that a sheet titled "Edit preset" is shown with the name "Journey" and a "7 / 24" count
Tap the "Rounds" row, tap "12" in the sheet, then tap "Done"
Verify that the "Rounds" row shows "×12"
Tap "Save" at the bottom of the sheet
Verify that the "Journey" card reads "30s on · 15s off · ×12" and is still captioned "On the Timer"
Verify that no "On the Timer · not saved" card is shown
Tap the "Journey" card
Tap "Delete"
Verify that a dialog titled "Delete Journey?" is shown saying "History keeps the workouts you did with it. The Timer keeps its settings."
Tap "Cancel"
Verify that the "Journey" sheet is still shown with "Edit" and "Delete"
Tap "Delete", then "Delete" in the dialog
Verify that "Journey" is no longer shown, "Yours" says "Nothing saved yet", and a card captioned "On the Timer · not saved" reads "30s on · 15s off · ×12"
Tap "New preset" in the title bar
Verify that a sheet titled "New preset" is shown with a "Name" field whose placeholder is "30/15 ×12", then tap "Cancel"
Tap "Back"
Verify that the Timer tab is shown, its total labelled "Custom · Total", and the title bar shows a "Save as preset" button
